summary: Shasta County lookout built in 1934 and discontinued in 1947; a July 2012 photo caption shows only corner footings; FFLA county list marks the tower gone.

facts.status_note: FFLA county list marks the tower gone; a photo dated July 17, 2012 says the corner footings are all that is left of the building

Photo dated July 17, 2012: only the corner footings of the lookout building are left

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The October 1947 report says the station was discontinued; the Peakbagging caption says the building was still there in 1948. Both fit if the station ended while the building stood for at least another year.

notes_for_editor: Name reuse: a YouTube video titled 'California Views: Bunch Grass Lookout' (2024 per search snippet; the fetched page shows only the title) and a weather camera named 'Bunch Grass Lookout 1' in Shasta (opencctv.org) exist. Neither page we read ties them to this 1934 site, so the story does not use them; an editor may want to check whether a present-day lookout carries this name on Hatchet Mountain or elsewhere. The opencctv coordinates (about 40.87, -121.77, from a search snippet and not confirmed on the page) are about 7 km from the record position. Peakbagging gives elevation 5500 ft (about 1,676 m); the record has no elevation field, so it was not added. Agency left out: Peakbagging says the site is located in the Shasta-Trinity National Forest, not who manages it. The Peakbagging table row lists the same site name. The statewide FFLA list row above Bunchgrass shows NHLR US 300, CA 29, which is Bully Choop Lookout in our NHLR cache, so the statewide row cells are misaligned; the county table is used.
